description:
Port-map §8 MVP. Bulk of the component work, but trimmed.

Must ship for Phase 4 MVP:
- Multi-line editable text state.
- Grapheme-aware cursor position (String.graphemes + display width
  via :unicode_util or cached East Asian Width table).
- Word-wrap render at width, respecting wide chars.
- Insert/delete at cursor (char, backspace).
- Cursor movement: left, right, home (Ctrl+A), end (Ctrl+E),
  word-left (Alt+B), word-right (Alt+F).
- Submit on Enter.
- Plain character insertion (including wide CJK).

Explicitly deferred to 4.1:
- Kill ring (Ctrl+W/U/K/Alt+D/Alt+Y).
- Undo/redo stack with coalescing.
- Slash-command autocomplete.
- File-path autocomplete (tab completion).
- Paste markers / bracketed-paste atomic undo.
- History navigation.

Tests: port-map §14.1 (input.test.ts cursor + wrap subset).

TDD:
- Single-char insert, backspace, delete.
- Cursor movement (atoms for each direction).
- Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E.
- Wide-char insertion tracks display width correctly.
- Word-wrap at width with CJK boundary.

Depends on .7.
title: Editor component: multi-line with grapheme-aware wrap + cursor
